candidates.summary: the readiness gate is bound to plan.Realms[0], so one realm that does not answer 200 aborts the whole preview
candidates.failure_scenario: render() waits with waitReady(c.Base, urlOf(plan.Realms[0]), cfg.timeout, died), and waitReady only returns nil on HTTP 200 for that one path. plan.Realms[0] is whatever sorts first in the affected set: for a change to examples/gno.land/p/nt/avl/pager/v0 plus a gnoweb file it is gno.land/r/demo/defi/grc20factory, neither a changed realm nor one of the four curated gnowebSeedRealms. Any realm gnodev does not serve 200 for - one it failed to deploy, a draft package, a Render that panics on the empty path - makes waitReady poll until cfg.timeout and return "gnoweb not ready after <timeout>", render() propagates it, and the job dies with no artifact and no comment: the gnoweb screenshots and every other realm's page are lost to one unrelated realm, under an error message that blames gnoweb.
candidates.verify_by: stand a server that answers 200 on / and 500 on /r/demo/broken, call waitReady on each: the root probe returns nil, the realm probe returns "gnoweb not ready after 3s" while the server is up
candidates.evidence: go test -run TestWaitReadyProbeIsOneRealm -v . : "probe=/r/demo/broken err=gnoweb not ready after 3s (server healthy, 4 requests served)" - PASS. Determinism run alongside: "Realms[0]=gno.land/r/demo/defi/grc20factory probe=/r/demo/defi/grc20factory" for changed=[examples/gno.land/p/nt/avl/pager/v0/pager.gno, gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/app.go], realms=8 changed_realms=0 gnoweb=true.

candidates.summary: a realm the pull request deletes is invisible to the plan, so the preview never mentions the removal
candidates.failure_scenario: changed.txt is `git diff --name-only $base $HEAD_SHA` (pr-preview.yml:64), which lists deleted paths. BuildPlan resolves every such path through byDir, built from LoadPkgs(root) over the head tree, so a deleted realm's directory is absent and `byDir[path.Dir(f)]` is nil: the file is dropped at line 220 with no record. A pull request that only removes realms produces Empty()==true and the workflow prints "nothing to preview"; one that removes gno.land/r/x/a and edits gno.land/r/x/b publishes a preview naming only b, so the reviewer reads a preview that silently omits the change with the largest blast radius.
candidates.verify_by: BuildPlan(root, []string{"examples/gno.land/r/does/not/exist/lib.gno"}, 25) returns an empty plan with no Dropped and no error; compare against the same path present in the tree

candidates.summary: a dot-prefixed directory is skipped with return nil, not fs.SkipDir, so WalkDir still descends into it
candidates.failure_scenario: LoadPkgs returns nil for any entry whose name starts with a dot, which tells WalkDir to keep walking that subtree; every directory under it is still visited and os.ReadDir'ed. A hidden tree dropped under examples/gno.land - a tool cache, a vendored .git - is walked in full on every plan and render invocation for nothing. fs.SkipDir is the one-word fix and states the intent the current line only implies.
candidates.verify_by: read filepath.WalkDir's contract: only fs.SkipDir prunes a directory; confirm no caller of LoadPkgs relies on descending into dot directories
